scope: Six D3D8/9 2D/cube/volume SetLOD entry points share managed-pool selection, clamping, local DWORD storage, exact old-value returns and SET_TEXTURE_LOD encoding. Non-managed textures ignore requests; repeated calls still emit and local state remains available after a failed void-style submission. Real XP verifies live resource LOD inside state-block recording without capturing it, all four pools, and seven known-color mip/filter/MAXMIPLEVEL cases for each texture kind and API. Guest CPU replies are explicitly simulated; separate GPU replay checks 42 actual replies and 172032 pixels on each backend. The host ignores MAXMIPLEVEL with NONE while still applying resource LOD, matching pinned Wine visual results, and combines both floors with POINT. The earlier texture-copy sampling probe is corrected to explicitly use POINT, its XP fixture is refreshed and both backends validate all 84 frames/252 probes. Full 53-page SwiftShader target and 533-case Metal conformance pass on the rebuilt bundle; the two new/refreshed pages also run on Metal. Does not claim Microsoft HAL measurements, complete Reset/cursor/gamma/private-data/pacing/surface-identity/additional-swapchain contracts, D3D8 wrapping or completed stages 4/5/6.
